meta.source: National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI), product and UPI ecosystem statistics, captured by the local Data Bank
meta.vintageNote: NPCI publishes no revision date for its statistics and edits past rows in place without notice; these are its tables as the Data Bank captured them on the archiveCapturedDate.
meta.revisionPolicy: NPCI edits past rows in place without notice (it revised April 2023's UPI volume, and NETC's February and March 2026 in October 2026). Each capture is the table as NPCI then showed it; the Data Bank keeps every capture.
meta.base: NPCI UPI ecosystem statistics: apps (from December 2020)
meta.coverage: UPI by the app the payment was made from, each month since December 2020: every app NPCI lists, with payments started by customers, business-to-customer and business-to-business payments, number and value
meta.sourceTitle: NPCI, UPI ecosystem statistics: UPI apps (monthly)
meta.note: NPCI's app table, printed in million and ₹ crore, stored as counts and rupees. An app's total is the sum of customer-initiated, B2C and B2B payments; on-us payments (payer and payee on the same bank's app) are printed beside the total for some apps in some months and are not part of it. Apps enter and leave NPCI's list, and NPCI's labels change spelling; lines are keyed on the app's name with spaces and punctuation removed, and the Paytm app's two 2024 spellings ('Paytm', 'Paytm (OCL)', alternating month by month) are one line. Where NPCI printed the same name twice in one month with different numbers (two 'Others' rows in August 2025 and a few 2023-24 months), both rows are kept, told apart by NPCI's serial number. June to November 2020 the tab served a different table, so apps start in December 2020. The sum of all apps runs a little above or below UPI's monthly total depending on the month.
